data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"An append-only event log must require neither pure idempotency nor pure safety, but rather 'exactly-once semantics at the application layer achieved through idempotent writes' \u2014 the writer must be idempotent, and the log infrastructure must be safe (crash-resistant, atomic). The distinction is one of layering: idempotency is a property of the writer's operation on the log, while safety is a property of the log's storage mechanism. At-least-once delivery is a transport-layer guarantee; deterministic replay is an application-layer requirement; idempotency bridges the two by making the application-layer outcome independent of transport-layer delivery multiplicity.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the problem treats the log as a single monolithic system without layering, the separation may be artificial.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the log storage is assumed safe by construction (e.g., using sqlite with WAL), the safety requirement is vacuous and only idempotency is a live requirement.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the writer and storage are the same component (e.g., a library writing directly to a file), the layering distinction may not hold.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Layer the system: transport (at-least-once delivery) \u2192 log infrastructure (safe storage: atomic, crash-resistant, durable) \u2192 writer operation (idempotent: same log effect regardless of delivery count) \u2192 replay (deterministic: final log \u2192 fixed derivation). Each layer has a different requirement. The log infrastructure must be safe (no partial writes, no corruption) \u2014 this is a property of the storage engine, not the writer. The writer must be idempotent \u2014 this is a property of the operation, not the storage. At-least-once delivery at the transport layer can duplicate messages; idempotency at the writer layer absorbs the duplicates; safety at the storage layer ensures each individual append is atomic and durable. The log 'requires idempotency of its writers' and 'requires safety of its storage,' and these are distinct requirements at distinct layers.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
